description: Serves Oracle Forms module content (.fmb/.mmb/.pll/.olb) from a directory to MCP clients.
name: io.github.aoreshkov/oracle-forms-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Same as --converted-dir, for clients that set environment variables rather than arguments. The flag wins when both are given.
environmentVariables.name: OFMCP_CONVERTED_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Same as --convert-command, for clients that set environment variables rather than arguments. The flag wins when both are given.
environmentVariables.name: OFMCP_CONVERT_COMMAND

packageArguments.description: Directory containing the Oracle Forms modules (in copy-mode, the pre-converted *_fmb.xml/*.pld files live here). Mount it into the container and point --forms-dir at the mount.
packageArguments.name: --forms-dir

packageArguments.description: Optional. Directory the converted XML / .pld text forms are kept in — one flat directory for all modules, each file named after its module (orders_fmb.xml, utils.pld). Mount a writable volume and point this at it to keep the text forms outside the cache. Must not be the forms directory. Also settable as OFMCP_CONVERTED_DIR.
packageArguments.name: --converted-dir

packageArguments.description: Optional. Site-supplied converter run instead of Oracle's frmf2xml, as `<command> <module>` with the working directory set to the module's cache directory. Mount the script into the container and point this at it. Also settable as OFMCP_CONVERT_COMMAND.
packageArguments.name: --convert-command

title: Oracle Forms
